adjudication: equal labels become truth including UNCERTAIN/OOS; conflicts require separate real human coordinator with case evidence and both locked rationales, preserving A/B/conflict/adjudicated label
agreement_caveat: artificial class construction limits kappa interpretation
independence: no discussion, response exchange or label/rationale sharing before both initial submissions lock
intake: exact frozen case set, independent A/B destination, completed flag; no PII or confidence required

labels.NEGATIVE: applicable scope and evidence supports absence of target finding
labels.OUT_OF_SCOPE: cannot validly judge under frozen language/framework/rule scope
labels.POSITIVE: sufficient source evidence supports frozen SEC finding
labels.UNCERTAIN: insufficient evidence for reliable binary judgment
